headline: PINBALL: steel refuses steel
lede: The weakest game on the shelf got the physics it was missing: balls now deflect each other on the PINBALL playfield — pass one ball into another and the far one flies off, and a magnet-pinned ball becomes a post you can bank shots off. Sound and sparks included; no new scoring, just the feel a real table always had.

notes.text: #3217 shipped (PR #3219, 7e510f8): pairwise ball collision in the 240 Hz substep loop, restitution 0.8, magnet-pin-as-a-post; pinballcheck 97→109 with a proven-red mutant.

Never-dry rung worked end to end: warden target refused (slot b was live on #3129), QA-borrow blocked by two live QA sessions, idle-kick derived PINBALL gap 0, issue filed, claimed, built, shipped — all in one session.
pinballplay's 8000-tick game-over check is Date-seeded flake-prone (long rallies can beat it); Node soak says the sim drains every seed ≤8433 ticks. Red there = budget line, not a stuck ball.
